$comment: Sorts that key on an agent-ordering field but are not an agent list, plus the named alternate modes a user asks for. Entries are scoped to one function, never a whole file: the files that build agent lists all also contain a legitimate worktree-group or alternate-mode sort, and exempting the file would wave through the next agent sort added beside it. Every entry needs a reason. Agents rendered next to each other belong to compare_agent_canonical_order instead.

Picks ONE overseer to start, it does not order a list anybody sees. Liveness first, then least-recently-used last so the most recent wins -- the same rule the service uses to choose a session to reuse (agent_launch_routes.rs). A canonical display order would pick by display position, which is not liveness.
